player_prompt.intro:
UnguMdlali {player_id} kwi-Wild Tic Tac Toe.
Xa kuthelekiswa kwakho, unokwazi ukubeka ama-'X' okanye ama-'O' kwenye iskhokho esisemthethweni.
Uphumelela ngokulungisa izikhokho ezintathu zesimboli efanayo (X okanye O) mfuleni.
Ungaphumelela ngesimboli yeyiphi na leyo.
Khetha isenzo sakho usebenzisa ifomethi '[X 4]' ukubeka i-X kwindawo yesikhokho esikhulu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomati yemovo engalungi. Sebenzisa '[X 4]' noma '[O 2]' ifomati.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Inombolo yeseli engekho semthethweni: {cell}. Kufuneka ibe phakathi ko-0 no-8.

game_action.placed: Mdlali {player_id} wathabatha isithombe sakhe ({mark}) kwi selu {cell}
